title: UE UMG Authoring
description: Create or modify one Widget Blueprint through constrained short operations or UE Workflow, then verify hierarchy, bindings, compile state, and persistence.

recipes.title: Author and verify one Widget Blueprint
recipes.description: Inspect a widget asset, apply bounded hierarchy and layout edits, then read back and compile-validate the result.

inputs.name: edits
inputs.description: Explicit widget names, classes, parents, properties, slot types, and layout values requested by the caller; ask for missing design choices rather than inventing them.

inputs.name: createIfMissing
inputs.description: Whether a missing Widget Blueprint may be created.

inputs.name: saveOnSuccess
inputs.description: Explicit persistence decision; false keeps the package dirty.

steps.purpose: Read current widget assets, hierarchy, bindings, and dirty state before editing.
Create and edit the widget tree; route continuous multi-step edits through UE Workflow.
Create and validate one event handler atomically when requested outside Workflow.
Confirm hierarchy, binding signatures, compile validity, and final dirty state.
When the caller provides an existing live PIE session and requests visual acceptance, read the runtime widget tree and inspect a capture from that exact session.
Compile or save only when explicitly requested and not already finalized by Workflow.

result.summary: Verified Widget Blueprint edit with hierarchy, binding, compile, diff, and persistence evidence.
evidence: widget asset identity and root hierarchy
widget count, parent-child order, and slot layout
binding handler existence and signature match
workflow run ID and structural diff for multi-step edits
runtime widget identity and inspected image provenance when visual acceptance was requested
success: one Widget Blueprint was the primary edit scope
multi-step edits used one approved Workflow plan
the final hierarchy and bindings were read back
requested visual acceptance used an actual rendered capture rather than serialized offsets
the asset was saved only when explicitly requested

resources.description: Short-operation versus Workflow routing, parameter aliases, persistence, and verification.
